using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
namespace CobolCS.Generated;
/// <summary>CLI が開始したローカル記録へ構造化された完了または停止点を追記します。</summary>
internal static class ExecutionEvidence
{
    internal static void Save(string? path, object? result, Exception? error)
    {
        if (path == null) return;
        var record = JsonNode.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path))!;
        var noOp = result?.GetType().GetProperty("HasNoOpCalls")?.GetValue(result) as bool? == true;
        record["status"] = error != null ? "failed" : noOp ? "incomplete" : "completed";
        record["hasNoOpCalls"] = noOp;
        record["internalTrace"] = JsonNode.Parse(Characterization.Serialize(error == null ? result?.GetType().GetProperty("InternalTrace")?.GetValue(result) : error.Data["InternalTrace"]));
        if (error != null)
        {
            record["failure"] = new JsonObject
            {
                ["exceptionType"] = error.GetType().Name,
                ["source"] = JsonNode.Parse(Characterization.Serialize((error as ExecutionException)?.SourceLocation ?? error.Data["SourceLocation"] as SourceLocation)),
                ["dependencyTrace"] = JsonNode.Parse(Characterization.Serialize(error.Data["DependencyTrace"])),
            };
            record["diagnostic"] = error.Message;
        }
        File.WriteAllText(path, record.ToJsonString(new System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true }));
    }
}
